preToolUse.bash: command -v rtok >/dev/null 2>&1 && exec rtok hook PreToolUse --host copilot; [ -x "$HOME/.ketch/bin/rtok" ] && exec "$HOME/.ketch/bin/rtok" hook PreToolUse --host copilot; true; exit 0
preToolUse.powershell: $r = (Get-Command rtok -CommandType Application -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -First 1).Source; if (-not $r) { $k = Join-Path $env:USERPROFILE '.ketch\bin\rtok.exe'; if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $k) { $r = $k } }; if ($r) { & $r hook PreToolUse --host copilot; exit $LASTEXITCODE }; exit 0
